positions.commentary: Visa maintains a neutral dashboard that tracks stablecoin transactions, which have reached a high volume.
Coinbase offers a wallet that users can download to try stablecoins and see the low fees.
PayPal is expected to enter the stablecoin market alongside other major financial institutions.

thesis: This episode argues that the future of digital finance lies in the widespread adoption of stablecoins by major institutions like Visa, Stripe, and PayPal, driven by their utility in treasury management and international invoicing. It posits that while regulatory scrutiny regarding reserves remains a key debate, compliant issuers with 100% backing are the clear winners in this emerging infrastructure.
